articles.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
articles.snippet: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

articles.title: Changing of Lagarde: How the candidates to be next ECB president view bitcoin, stablecoins and CBDCs
articles.snippet: ECB President Christine Lagarde will step down from her post in February 2027, and none of the primary candidates to succeed her are great fans of crypto.

articles.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
articles.snippet: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.

articles.title: Zelle picks Solana for ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments
articles.snippet: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.
